# Astra

> Astra is a Vedic (sidereal) astrology and numerology web app. Given a person's exact birth date,
> time, and place, it computes a real astrological birth chart — not a template — and generates
> chart-specific content: daily and weekly readings, natal chart analysis, compatibility between
> two people, three numerology systems (Pythagorean, Chaldean, Vedic), a real-time Vedic Timing
> Engine (Rahu Kaal, Choghadiya, Hora, Abhijit Muhurta computed from actual sunrise/sunset
> astronomy for the user's exact location), and a Spiritual Wellness section (guided reflections,
> mantras, festival calendar).

Astrological and numerological facts on Astra are always computed deterministically from real
astronomical data and classical calculation rules — never invented or guessed by an AI model. The
AI (Google Gemini) is only ever used to narrate precomputed facts into readable prose; it never
determines a planetary position, house, dasha period, or number itself.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://astraastroconsultancy.com/): product overview and sign-up
- [Pricing](https://astraastroconsultancy.com/pricing): subscription plans

## Notes

Most of Astra's features (birth chart, daily readings, numerology, the Timing Engine, Spiritual
Wellness) require a free account, since they're computed from a user's personal birth details and
aren't meaningful without them.
